thread:
emma_finance: Heads-up: Vendor TidalCore submitted INV-1443 with PO PO-33002 but split the billed amount across two cost centers (CC-10 and CC-48). AP can't auto-match single-line PO to multi-cc invoice.
raj_procure: Did vendor indicate split on the PO? Our PO is single cost center (CC-10).
jon_ap: AP log: invoice lines show 70% to CC-10, 30% to CC-48. PO-33002 expected 100% CC-10. System flagged mismatch and placed INV-1443 in exceptions. Link: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/INV-1443
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-1443 flagged: cost center split not matching PO. Required action: procurement confirmation and approver routing.
vendor_bot: TidalCore portal: "We support multi-cost allocation for enterprise customers; PO notes didn't include split. Happy to reissue if needed."
emma_finance: Services delivered match PO. Suggest we accept split but need procurement sign-off and request vendor reissue showing allocation. Raj, ok to approve split?
raj_procure: We can accept multi-CC allocation for this vendor, but need documented approval and updated PO change notice. Please capture allocation percentages in PO amendment.
jon_ap: I can provisionally code invoice with split allocation (70% CC-10 / 30% CC-48) and route to approvers for each cost center. Will flag with TEMP-ALLOC and request PO amendment.
ap_bot: Automated: Applied TEMP-ALLOC. Invoice routed to approvers for CC-10 and CC-48.
emma_finance: Approved allocation for CC-10 portion; tagging @raj_procure for final sign-off on CC-48.
raj_procure: Approved. I'll issue PO amendment PO-33002-A to reflect split. Also will ask TidalCore to reissue invoice referencing PO-33002-A.
jon_ap: Done  coded invoice per allocation, routed for approvals, and scheduled payment net-30 pending reissue. AP ticket AP-5321 created to track reissue and PO amendment.
ap_bot: Automated: Reminder set to follow up in 10 days for vendor reissue.
emma_finance: Thanks team  closing when reissued invoice and PO amendment are in AP.
